scope: Read-only implementation and data-quality evidence for H2 adjudication of the 23 already-frozen targeted formula rows.
purpose: Resolve the H1-identified distinction between a similarly named local column and a demonstrably equivalent deterministic derivation. This addendum can establish local implementation details but cannot authorize a literature formula, change a source claim, create a new family, or rescue a construct mismatch.

TFC001.local_formula: 1 - mean Jaccard overlap between the focal reference set and prior comparison-paper reference sets.
TFC001.comparison_rule: Only strictly prior papers with the same OpenAlex primary field and at least one co-cited focal reference enter the comparison set.
TFC001.mandatory_h2_check: Approve only if the frozen English source explicitly defines the all-reference/all-co-citing variant as a valid source variant. Do not rewrite the local implementation as the 10-year/3-year variant.

TFC006.local_formula: Number of distinct nonmissing reference field IDs.

TFC007.local_formula: One minus Gini across occupied reference-field counts.
TFC007.single_category_rule: A single occupied category has balance 1 within observed support.

TFC008.local_formula: Mean one-minus-cosine distance over unordered occupied reference-field pairs.
TFC008.distance_time_window: For a focal year y, field profiles use citation events from y-5 through y-1 only.

TFC009_and_TFC011.local_formula: Twice the sum over unordered field pairs of p_a * p_b * d_ab, algebraically equal to the ordered-pair Rao-Stirling sum.
TFC009_and_TFC011.distance_time_window: For a focal year y, field profiles use citation events from y-5 through y-1 only.

TFC010.local_formula: relative variety * one-minus-Gini * prior-window mean field disparity.
TFC010.mandatory_h2_check: The local formula is an explicitly adapted T0 implementation. Reject exact correspondence if the source requires the fixed 2015 JCR universe or a post-focal distance matrix.

TFC012.local_formula: Mean of focal publication year minus reference year over references with known nonfuture years.
TFC012.zero_and_missing_rule: Same-year age is valid zero; no valid reference year is missing, not zero.

TFC013.local_formula: Number of strictly prior bibliographic-coupling neighbors divided by the number of valid focal references.
TFC013.edge_rule: An unweighted edge requires at least one shared reference.

TFC014_and_TFC015.local_formula: OpenAlex paper authors_count, with zero treated as missing in the v3 candidate operationalization.
TFC014_and_TFC015.audit: log1p author count agrees with the frozen control field to floating-point precision.

TFC016.local_formula: Whitespace-split focal title word count; an empty title is missing.

TFC017.local_formula: Count of unique focal paper-reference edges; the raw count is retained and log1p is a separate transform.
TFC017.audit: log1p raw edge count agrees with the frozen control field to floating-point precision.

TFC018.data_quality_failure: openalex_institution_count is row-wise identical to openalex_author_count for all 118059 candidate rows.
TFC018.mandatory_h2_decision: The field cannot support an institutional-breadth formula and must not be approved.

TFC019_and_TFC020.local_formula: Distinct author-affiliation country count; international collaboration is one only when the known count exceeds one.
TFC019_and_TFC020.zero_and_missing_rule: A frozen count of zero is treated as missing country metadata, not as observed single-country collaboration.

TFC021.local_formula: Stable categorical source_id with source_display_name as label.

TFC023.mandatory_h2_check: Do not equate OpenAlex field levels with a source-specific manual taxonomy without explicit crosswalk evidence.
